To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

students who are more motivated, who have more social interaction, who come from higher socioeconomic backgrounds, and who are more involved in extracurricular activities, tend to achieve better grades in English language learning.

the students who have a positive attitude toward English language learning, who come from high socioeconomic background, whose parents have high education and who participate in extracurricular English activities have higher English achievement than those who have a negative attitude towards English language learning, come from low socioeconomic background, whose parent has low education and who participate less in extracuricular English activities.
The students' achievement in the English language learning is affected by their attitude, socioeconomic, extracurricular and social factors.

the effect that some of the factors have on the achievement in English language of secondary school students in the province of Almería.
the relationship between the factors (attitudinally, social, socioeconomic and extracurriculum) and students' achievement of English language learning.
the relationship between English language learning achievement and some factors.

there is a significant relationship between the variables of the factors and students’ achievement in English language.

the students' attitude toward learning English, social interaction, family background, and extracurrucular activities have significant relationship to the students' English achievement.
